successCriteria: Dirty-input/entry source coverage and preflight pass before feature:run admin:dev.

untouchedSurfaces: Launch/read-only task does not grant application or asset edits despite owning-app server scope.

impact.entryPoint: Existing localhost4173 protected Admin shell and two workspace read-only routes.
impact.dataWrite: Node server process only; no source mutations. Local UI may retain preexisting local draft caches.
impact.backendContract: Normal authenticated read-only Admin boot, no live writes while R02 remains blocked.
impact.adminVisibility: Preserve Content/AI Studio/Growth capability boundaries, no raw private content access.
impact.privacySafety: Static path allowlist excludes env/internal documents; runtime config only approved public anon key, no secrets.
impact.observability: Browser checks distinguish login blocked/server unavailable/read-only verified; no fake publish.
impact.rollback: Stop only the server launched by this task, restore viewport; no application data rollback.

canonicalContracts: Existing Admin capabilities/auth/runtime public-path allowlist unchanged.
